Subject: Concourse corner kiosk — sightlines, signage specs, and collateral kit counts

Marissa — putting this thread together after the site walk. We confirmed the corner space on Concourse C (near Gate 4). A few open items before I give the green light to ShowWorks to finalize crates: 

1) Backwall logo size/placement: need final approval (we want logo at top-left 48in wide to avoid overlap with neighboring sightlines).
2) Signage: three hanging ID signs + two double-sided kiosks. Confirmed material (foamcore vs sintra?) — preferences?
3) Collateral kits: marketing asked for 600 one-sheets, 400 stickers, 160 demo USBs split across 4 kits (ship 4 crates). Confirm counts and whether we should add an extra kit for on-site reserves.
4) Shipping window: ShowWorks proposed crates arriving Mon 06/14 for build Monday-Tuesday. Can we compress to arrive Monday morning only? Costs go up for split arrivals.

Attaching the latest floorplan they sent (v4) and signage specs. Can everyone reply with approvals or changes by EOD Monday so I can send to ShowWorks?

Thanks —
Connor
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Concourse corner kiosk — sightlines, signage specs, and collateral kit counts

Hi Connor / Marissa — thanks for the walk-through yesterday. Quick answers from our side and a few notes: 

- Backwall: 48in width is fine but please confirm final artwork with bleed; if the logo uses spot varnish we need 72hrs lead.
- Hanging IDs: Sintra is recommended for longer shows; foamcore is lighter/cheaper but can warp in humidity. Recommend Sintra for two hanging IDs and one cut-to-shape show ID for the corner.
- Collateral kits: Shipping 4 crates (4x kits) is fine. We recommend a 5th reserve kit staged on-site (small fee).
- Shipping window: We can consolidate to arrive on Monday 06/14 morning (dock window 0800-1100) but there is a $320 labor surcharge for single-day concentrated unload; if you keep the Tues window the surcharge is waived.

I've attached an updated manifest with suggested crate packing (shipping_manifest_draft.xlsx) and marked sightline clearance on the floorplan (v4). Also linking the DocuSign for the rental addendum (we need signature to reserve the Sintra hanging panels).

Elena Díaz
ShowWorks Client Services
